title: A Season of Stillness
subtitle: Twenty Reflections for the Journey
reader: General readers looking for a short daily devotional.
reader_problem: They want a calm daily practice and do not know where to start.
promise: Twenty short reflections for a quiet daily practice.
transformation: The reader builds a short daily habit of reflection.

units.title: The Journey Begins
units.thesis: Starting something you have never done before and surviving the first week of it.

units.title: A Season of Waiting
units.thesis: What a man does with a stretch of time where nothing is moving.

units.title: The Quiet Voice
units.thesis: Learning to notice a signal that is quieter than everything around it.

units.title: Letting Go
units.thesis: Releasing a grudge that has cost more to hold than to drop.

units.title: The Path Ahead
units.thesis: Choosing a direction when the map runs out at the edge of the paper.

units.title: Trusting the Process
units.thesis: Staying in a slow process when you would rather force the result.

units.title: A New Perspective
units.thesis: Looking at an old problem from a position you have never stood in.

units.title: The Inner Work
units.thesis: The work you do on yourself that nobody else can see or verify.

units.title: Moments of Stillness
units.thesis: Building a pause into a day that has no room in it.

units.title: Finding Your Center
units.thesis: Locating the thing you orient on when everything else moves.

units.title: The Deeper Call
units.thesis: Hearing a request that asks for more than you planned to give.

units.title: Learning to Receive
units.thesis: Accepting help, money, or praise without deflecting it.

units.title: A Posture of Openness
units.thesis: Staying open to a person you have already decided about.

units.title: The Gift of Presence
units.thesis: Giving somebody your attention instead of your advice.

units.title: Walking in Light
units.thesis: Moving through a place you cannot see the end of.

units.title: The Space Between
units.thesis: What happens in the gap between a decision and its result.

units.title: Choosing Gratitude
units.thesis: Naming what is working on a day when little is.

units.title: The Long Obedience
units.thesis: Doing one unremarkable thing for a very long time.

units.title: Becoming Who You Are
units.thesis: Growing into the person you already tell other people you are.

units.title: The Final Invitation
units.thesis: Accepting an offer that will change how the rest of it goes.

author: Chris G. Stewart
full_title: A Season of Stillness: Twenty Reflections for the Journey
